text: In retrospect, our record from this month circles a single appropriations fight. Forty-seven of us said "of homeland security"; nineteen paired it as "of homeland security dhs," and twenty-four of us said "fund the department." Richard J. Durbin first said the former, in 2013; the funding language was new to us this year. Alongside it, twenty-five of us said "the federal communications," nineteen the fuller "the federal communications commission." Twenty-one of us said "hunt suicide prevention for american veterans," twenty the truncation "clay hunt suicide prevention for american," first ours in 2013. Twenty of us said "the middle class," which André Carson first said among us, in 2011. We do not, from these figures alone, know why we converged, or who told us to; we know only that we did, and on which words.
